question: Queue item 20261030-1251-expand-dev-services-c696-u04-q01: does any step after the email step of the sign-ups of Auth0, Clerk, Stytch, WorkOS, LaunchDarkly, GrowthBook or Flagsmith ask for a phone number, and does an address at a public mail domain pass as the Work Email Address of GrowthBook and the Work email of LaunchDarkly? Read on 2026-11-01: no first step of the seven lists a phone field. The steps after registration that first-party pages name are: Auth0, a profile page (Account Type or Role) then a tenant name and a region; LaunchDarkly, a Complete profile screen (First name, Last name, Work email, Organization) then an email to verify; Flagsmith, an organisation; GrowthBook, a role, then an organization and a project; Stytch, an authentication type then a first project. The GrowthBook register form at app.growthbook.io asks for First Name, Work Email Address and Password, or Sign up with Google.
why: Only an account shows the steps after the email step, and no first-party page states that a phone step exists or does not. A registration with an email address on each service, noting every field, settles it; a phone step would change identity_cost.kind from email or card to any-phone or country-phone. Registering needs an account, so the step belongs to the operator.
